nodes.description: Owner address of the GHIToken contract (address internal owner).
Address where collected transfer fees are sent (address internal feeCollector).
Number of tokens in circulation (uint256 internal tokensCount).
Flag indicating whether token transfers are frozen (bool internal frozen).
Mapping from holder address to next delegated-transfer nonce.
Fixed fee amount in token units (uint256 internal fixedFee).
Minimum variable fee in token units.
Maximum variable fee in token units.
Variable fee numerator used in fee calculation.
Mapping from address to its flags (black list / zero fee).
Address of the smart contract delegated execution is forwarded to (address internal delegate).
Mapping from holder address to token balance (mapping(address=>uint256) internal accounts).
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount of approved allowance.
delegatable modifier: forwards the whole calldata via delegatecall when a delegate is configured, otherwise requires msg.value == 0.
GHIToken constructor: initializes fee parameters and sets owner = msg.sender and feeCollector = _feeCollector.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): checks frozen/blacklist flags, computes fee, moves tokens and fee, emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): checks allowance, balances, blacklist and fee, then moves tokens and fee.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowance of msg.sender for _spender and emits Approval.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender): returns remaining allowance from the nested allowances mapping.
balanceOf(address _owner): returns the token balance of the given owner.
totalSupply(): returns the current tokensCount.
createTokens(uint256 _value): owner-only minting of tokens, bounded by MAX_TOKENS_COUNT.
burnTokens(uint256 _value): owner-only burning of own tokens.
freezeTransfers(): owner-only function that sets frozen = true and emits Freeze.
unfreezeTransfers(): owner-only function that sets frozen = false and emits Unfreeze.
setOwner(address _newOwner): owner-only update of the owner address.
setFeeCollector(address _newFeeCollector): owner-only update of the fee collector address.
setFeeParameters(...): owner-only update of fixed/min/max variable fee and fee numerator, emits FeeChange.
setDelegate(address _delegate): owner-only update of the delegate address used by the delegatable modifier, emits Delegation.
calculateFee(uint256 _amount): computes variable fee with safeMul, clamps it and adds the fixed fee.
setFlags(address _address, uint256 _flags): owner-only update of address flags.
delegatedTransfer(...): verifies an ECDSA signature with ecrecover, validates nonce/balances/fees and moves tokens, fee and reward.
safeAdd(uint256 x, uint256 y): asserts no overflow and returns x + y.
safeSub(uint256 x, uint256 y): asserts no underflow and returns x - y.
safeMul(uint256 x, uint256 y): asserts no overflow and returns x * y.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for authorization, balances and allowances.
delegatecall inside the delegatable modifier: forwards calldata to the user-configurable delegate address, executing untrusted code in the contract storage context.
ecrecover over a signed payload in delegatedTransfer: recovers _from, which is used as an authorization principal.
Unchecked arithmetic increment nonces[_from] = _nonce + 1 in delegatedTransfer (raw '+', no safeMath).
Parameter _value of transfer/transferFrom: number of tokens to move, compared against balances and allowances.
Parameter _from of transferFrom/delegatedTransfer: source address whose balance/allowance is debited.
Parameter _fee of delegatedTransfer: reward paid to msg.sender from the signer's balance.
Parameter _nonce of delegatedTransfer: replay-protection nonce compared to and stored in nonces[_from].
Local uint256 fee in transfer/transferFrom: fee computed via calculateFee or forced to 0 for zero-fee addresses.
Local uint256 fromBalance in transfer/transferFrom: cached sender/source balance used for the balance checks.
Local uint256 spenderAllowance in transferFrom: cached allowances[_from][msg.sender] value.
Parameter _amount of calculateFee: transfer amount the fee is computed for.
Parameter _newOwner of setOwner: new privileged owner address.
Parameter _delegate of setDelegate: address that receives delegatecall-forwarded execution.

edges.reason: setOwner is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner); the caller controls whether the privileged branch executes.
setFeeCollector is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), an authorization check on the untrusted caller.
setFeeParameters is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), an authorization check on the untrusted caller.
setFlags is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), an authorization check on the untrusted caller.
setDelegate is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner); the caller controls the delegatecall target.
createTokens is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), restricting minting to the owner.
burnTokens is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), restricting burning to the owner.
freezeTransfers is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), restricting freezing to the owner.
unfreezeTransfers is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), restricting unfreezing to the owner.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor, establishing the privileged principal.
transfer reads accounts[msg.sender] and uses msg.sender as the transfer source and event argument.
transferFrom reads allowances[_from][msg.sender] and decrements the caller's allowance.
approve writes allowances[msg.sender][_spender] using the untrusted caller as owner key.
delegatedTransfer credits the _fee reward to accounts[msg.sender].
The recovered signer _from from ecrecover acts as the authorization principal for the delegated transfer.
delegatedTransfer invokes ecrecover inside its body to recover the signer address.
delegatedTransfer performs the unchecked integer increment nonces[_from] = _nonce + 1.
The unchecked nonce increment writes the new value into the nonces mapping.
The delegatecall in the delegatable modifier can re-enter transfer through forwarded calldata after/while external code executes.
The delegatecall in the delegatable modifier can re-enter transferFrom while state updates are in flight.
The delegatecall in the delegatable modifier can re-enter createTokens when the owner forwards execution to a delegate.
The delegatecall in the delegatable modifier can re-enter delegatedTransfer, re-executing balance and nonce logic.
The delegatable modifier executes the delegatecall unsafe operation when a delegate address is set.
transfer's _value parameter flows into the balance check and the safeSub/safeAdd amount arguments.
transferFrom's _value parameter flows into allowance, balance and fee checks and the subtraction.
transferFrom's _from parameter indexes allowances and accounts for the debit side.
delegatedTransfer's recovered/derived _from address keys the balance, allowance and nonce updates.
The _fee parameter is compared against the remaining balance and credited to msg.sender.
The _nonce parameter is compared with nonces[_from] and then used in the unchecked increment.
The local fee value is derived from calculateFee and subtracted from the sender balance via safeSub.
The cached fromBalance is passed to safeSub to compute the new sender balance.
The cached spenderAllowance is passed to safeSub when decrementing the allowance.
calculateFee's _amount parameter flows into safeMul with the variable fee numerator.
setOwner assigns the caller-supplied _newOwner into the privileged owner state variable.
setDelegate assigns the caller-supplied _delegate into the delegate state variable used by delegatecall.
calculateFee uses safeAdd to add the fixed fee to the clamped variable fee.
transfer calls safeSub to decrement the sender balance defensively.
transfer calls safeAdd to increment the recipient balance defensively.
transferFrom calls safeSub for allowance and balance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to increment the recipient balance.
delegatedTransfer calls safeAdd when crediting recipient, feeCollector and msg.sender.
delegatedTransfer calls safeSub repeatedly when deducting value, fee and reward from the balance.
createTokens uses safeAdd for accounts[msg.sender] and tokensCount.
burnTokens uses safeSub for accounts[msg.sender] and tokensCount.
createTokens increases the tokensCount state variable.
burnTokens decreases the tokensCount state variable.
createTokens credits accounts[msg.sender] through the accounts state mapping.
burnTokens debits accounts[msg.sender] through the accounts state mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter has no independent identity outside transfer; it only feeds the balance check and token movement of transfer.
The _from parameter is only meaningful as the debit key of transferFrom's allowance and balance logic.
The _fee parameter is a local reward amount consumed solely inside delegatedTransfer.
The _nonce parameter is only used for the replay check and increment inside delegatedTransfer.
The fee local variable is computed and consumed entirely within the transfer control flow.
The cached fromBalance local holds no cross-function semantics; it belongs to transfer's balance update.
The cached allowance local is produced and consumed only inside transferFrom.
The _amount parameter is solely the fee-computation input of calculateFee.
The _newOwner parameter is only assigned to the owner state variable inside setOwner.
The _delegate parameter is only assigned to the delegate state variable inside setDelegate.
